title: AI Compass
subtitle: A 1-to-5 star diagnostic of AI governance maturity, built around the questions buyers, regulators and investors ask.

sections.heading: What AI Compass Measures
sections.body:
AI Compass evaluates an organisation across four navigational dimensions — asking not just whether AI is being used, but whether it is aimed correctly, generating real value, supported by the right infrastructure, and architecturally sound under regulatory scrutiny.

① DIRECTION
Is the AI deployment aimed at the right business problem, with a clear and testable hypothesis?

② VALUE
Does the model create measurable, decision-driving value — or just produce dashboards?

③ READINESS
Do people, processes, and data infrastructure support deployment without creating insider risk or operational fragility?

④ INTEGRITY
Is the system lawful, auditable, and architecturally compliant with GDPR, EU AI Act, and sector-specific regulation?

sections.heading: The 5-Tier Maturity Scale
sections.body:
AI Compass benchmarks capabilities on a 1-to-5 star scale. Most early-stage ventures arrive at 1-2 stars. The diagnostic maps the gap and prescribes a sequenced path forward.

+++ What each tier looks like

1 STAR — FRAGMENTED
No inventory of the AI systems in use. No named owner. A buyer's security questionnaire cannot be answered without guessing.

2 STARS — STRUCTURED
The systems are listed and policies exist on paper. Compliance documentation is not connected to how the product is actually built and run.

3 STARS — INTEGRATED
Each system is classified under the EU AI Act and has a named owner. Human review is logged. Suppliers and sub-suppliers are mapped. Procurement questions are answered with evidence.

4 STARS — MONITORED
Controls are tested on a schedule. Model changes and incidents are logged and reviewed. Evidence can be produced on request, within days.

5 STARS — ASSURED
Governance is verified by an independent party, for example certification against ISO/IEC 42001 and ISO/IEC 27001. Monitoring is continuous, and human oversight is designed into the system.

sections.heading: Data Infrastructure & Automated Compliance
sections.body:
Before deploying AI algorithms, systems must be data-ready. AI Compass audits pipeline architecture and automated governance to ensure models remain performant, auditable, and legally defensible.

In regulated sectors, this is not optional — it is the difference between a competitive asset and a regulatory liability. The diagnostic output feeds directly into Polaris sprint design and the 6Sense qualification score.
